title: Arcos — sensor-fusion security platform and control centre for critical infrastructure and property
money_note: €5.5M seed round announced 2026-09-18 (tech.eu, the url; also HTGF release), stated in EUR; no FX needed.
summary: Munich-based Arcos runs a platform and its own control centre that combine signals from connected sensors to detect, assess, escalate and document physical security incidents at homes, commercial sites and critical infrastructure such as substations and railway stations. It raised a €5.5M seed round in September 2026 led by High-Tech Gründerfonds and Bayern Kapital.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: Arcos sells a combined platform plus its own 24/7 control centre that fuses alarm, camera and sensor signals and runs incident detection, assessment, escalation and documentation for homes, commercial sites, construction sites and critical infrastructure (railway stations, substations, data centres). Czech buyers are the same: property owners and operators of critical infrastructure. A Czech driver exists: zákon č. 266/2025 Sb. (zákon o kritické infrastruktuře, transposing Directive (EU) 2022/2557 CER) has been in force since 2025-08-19 and obliges designated entities to run risk assessments and resilience plans, take resilience measures and report incidents (HZS ČR page, fetched 2026-09-19, saved as feed-picks/support-hzs-kriticka-infrastruktura.html). Urgency 2: the duties are in force but designation of entities was due by 2026-07-17 and measures follow within months; no active enforcement found. Scale 2 (a sector: property security and critical-infrastructure operators). Recurrence 3 (monitoring is continuous; CER duties are permanent). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded about a year before the 2026-09-18 seed round (EU-Startups and HTGF round coverage, https://www.htgf.de/en/arcos-seed/, saved as feed-picks/de-arcos-htgf.html); seed stage only; no named customers or customer count in the sources read. Surfaces: google-cz, ares, own-funded-ledger (no Arcos and no alarm-receiving-centre record in data/signals/funded). FOUND: WESTPOINT a. s. (IČO 25635603, datumVzniku 1998-01-05) runs its own 24/7 dohledové a poplachové přijímací centrum (PCO) with 'více než 2500 objektů z celé ČR' connected (https://www.westpoint.cz/pco/, saved as feed-picks/cz-westpoint-pco.html) — competes: direct (sensor/alarm monitoring, incident assessment and response from a control centre); maturity: established (selling since 1998, public customer count 2,500+ sites). SECURITAS ČR s.r.o. (IČO 43872026, since 1991-11-12) sells PCO monitoring 24/7 with the MySecuritas client portal for incident reporting (https://www.securitas.cz/bezpecnostni-sluzby/monitorovaci-sluzby/pco-monitoring/, saved as feed-picks/cz-securitas-pco.html) — competes: direct; maturity: established by years (>=3 years; second limb not separately verified beyond Securitas group scale). title: Orbisk — AI camera-and-scale food-waste monitor for professional kitchens

summary: Dutch Orbisk sells the Orbi, an AI camera-and-scale monitor fitted above kitchen bins that identifies and weighs every discarded food item, on a monthly subscription to hotels, contract caterers, cruise ships and restaurants. It raised an oversubscribed €8M+ Series A in December 2024 and reports operating in over 40 countries.

Buyers: school, hospital and care-home canteens (mostly municipal/regional příspěvkové organizace), contract caterers, hotel chains. The revised EU Waste Framework Directive sets the first binding food-waste targets, a 30% per-capita cut in retail, restaurants, food service and households by end-2030 (EnviWeb 2026-08-07, saved as cz-enviweb-kitro.html), which member states must measure and report. Urgency 1: dated EU target more than 18 months out, Czech transposition not yet in force. Scale 2: the food-service sector. Recurrence 3: waste is generated and measured daily, sold as a monthly subscription. title: Zenobē — electric bus and truck fleets-as-a-service: vehicle and battery financing plus depot charging built and run for operators
money_note: €325M DEBT facility (not equity) from a seven-bank syndicate, financial close announced 2025-07-24 on the company release (the url); stated in EUR, no FX needed. Earmarked for EU/EEA fleets: up to 1,000 e-buses, e-trucks and chargers. Zenobē reports >£3.2bn raised since 2017 across rounds (electrive/Sustainable Bus coverage, not re-fetched).
summary: London-based Zenobē finances electric buses and trucks and their batteries, then designs, builds, maintains and operates the depot charging and energy management, so a bus operator pays per vehicle instead of buying the kit. In July 2025 it closed a €325M debt facility to take this fleets-as-a-service model into continental Europe.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: Zákon 360/2022 Sb. (Czech transposition of the Clean Vehicles Directive) binds every above-threshold public procurement AND every public-service bus contract (§2(1)(c)) for class I/A (city and suburban) buses: 60 % of vehicles from 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31 must be low-emission, half of that (30 %) zero-emission (§4(1)(b), §4(4); zakonyprolidi.cz, saved cz-zakon-360-2022.html). The buyers are the Czech bus operators that win regional PSO contracts, including private ones (Arriva, ČSAD groups, COMETT PLUS), who must fund e-buses and build depot chargers themselves: Středočeský kraj approved ~50 e-buses for nine PID areas in 2028–2030, with chargers 'v areálech jednotlivých dopravců' (Dopraváček 2026-09-13, saved cz-dopravacek-stc-elektrobusy.html). Czech e-bus finance is ~90 % dependent on IROP subsidies, and a Czech trade outlet already named 'elektrobus jako služba' as the model for operators who cannot reach subsidies (Busportal, saved cz-busportal-quo-vadis.html, ~2020); subsidies can be clawed back if vehicles miss mileage or delivery targets (e15 2023-11-02, saved cz-e15-elektrobusy-dotace.html) — a risk the as-a-service model moves to the supplier. Urgency 2: the 60 % quota period is in force since 2026-01-01 and every contract signed now counts; no active Czech enforcement (§11 přestupky) was verified, so not 3. Recurrence 2: multi-year service contracts, re-procured with each PSO/fleet cycle. Scale 2: the Czech bus sector. MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED — operating since 2017 (the url, 'began operations in 2017'); named customers National Express (130 buses, Coventry), Go-Ahead (Oxford depot, 104 charge points), Grupo Julià (44 buses, Barcelona), 3,400+ fleet vehicles in 120 depots (all the url). title: Ecov — carpooling lines run as public transport for rural and peri-urban authorities

summary: Ecov designs and operates carpooling lines for French local authorities: fixed stops on commuter corridors where passengers are matched in real time with passing drivers, run as a public mobility service where buses are too thin to pay. It raised an €11.75M Series A in May 2023 and ran 55 lines in about 30 territories.

Carpooling lines are a way for a kraj or micro-region to add rural capacity without drivers or vehicles; the buyer is the kraj transport organiser or a svazek obcí. Recurrence 3: a daily commuting service under a standing contract. Scale 2: regional public transport. MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED — developing the solution for 8 years by 2023, i.e. since ~2015 (the url, 'depuis 8 ans'); customer count 55 carpool lines in about thirty territories (the url); Series A €11.75M (the url). title: ecoworks — industrial serial renovation of apartment buildings with prefabricated facade and roof modules
money_note: €23M received 2026-03-31 (EU-Startups) to deliver a 12-building, 192-flat serial renovation for the Wohnungsverein Hagen cooperative; stated in EUR, no FX. The page presents it as capital for this project, not as an equity round. Last equity round: €40M Series A led by World Fund, 2023-12-14, total funding then over €82M (tech.eu, saved as de-ecoworks-2023.html).
summary: Berlin-based ecoworks renovates occupied apartment blocks serially: it scans and plans buildings digitally, then mounts factory-made timber-frame facade and roof modules with windows and insulation built in, cutting weeks of on-site work. It received €23M in March 2026 for Germany's largest cooperative serial renovation, after a €40M Series A in 2023.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: Panel estates house about 28% of Czech households (over 40% in Prague, Ústí and Moravia-Silesia, per Sociologický ústav AV ČR as cited by Deník 2026-07-14, saved as cz-denik-panelaky.html). The same article reports that panel blocks insulated cheaply in 1995-2010 now face a second round of repairs because of damp, thermal bridges and failing balconies. The buyers are the same as ecoworks' Hagen client: SVJ, housing cooperatives (bytová družstva) and municipal landlords. EU driver: the EPBD recast (Directive (EU) 2024/1275) had to be transposed by 29 May 2026 and requires the average primary energy use of the residential stock to fall 16% by 2030, with 55% of the cut coming from the worst-performing buildings. Register p-0024 already records that Czechia is late on this. Urgency 1: the 2030 milestone is more than 18 months away and Czech owners have no enforced duty yet. Scale 2: one sector (multi-family housing). Recurrence 1: one deep renovation per building per generation, although the national stock gives a vendor a long pipeline. MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED. Founded 2019 (EU-Startups 2026-03-31, the url). Already 'implementing its tech on a large number of buildings in Germany' in December 2023 (tech.eu 2023-12-14, saved), which puts selling at about 3 years or more by 2026-09. €40M Series A in 2023 (same tech.eu source). Named customer: Wohnungsverein Hagen eG (the url). CZ CHECK: Czech-language queries: 'sériová renovace bytových domů prefabrikované fasádní panely Česko'; 'revitalizace panelového domu na klíč prefabrikované dřevěné fasádní moduly firma'; 'Energiesprong Česká republika pilotní projekt bytový dům'. Surfaces: google-cz, ares, own-funded-ledger (no Czech renovation entrant in data/signals/funded). FOUND: HOLBORN GROUP s.r.o. (IČO 26429403, datumVzniku 2001-01-23, per ARES), which sells turnkey revitalisation of panel and apartment buildings: '850 + Počet zrekonstruovaných domů', active since 2001 (holborn.cz, saved as cz-holborn.html). Competes: direct on the outcome (energy renovation of apartment blocks sold to SVJ and cooperatives). Maturity: established (over 22 years, a public count of 850+ buildings). Holborn uses conventional on-site methods (ETICS, ventilated facades, loggia extensions). Other conventional turnkey contractors also surfaced: ŠMÍD STAVEBNÍ, Fasády Šimek, IVPS Praha, TOMIreko (competes: direct on the outcome, maturity not checked). No Czech player selling industrialised serial renovation with prefabricated facade modules was found, and no Czech Energiesprong pilot: the only relevant hits were TZB-info and James Hardie articles about a Munich project. Verdict: taken for the outcome, because established Czech contractors already sell turnkey panel-block renovation. The prefab serial method is absent, so a builder would be entering on method, cost and speed against incumbents rather than into an empty market. IČO 03643174 (datumVzniku 2014-12-15). PASSED. title: Deckard Technologies — short-term-rental compliance and tourist-tax recovery software for local governments
money_note: $3.9M (A$6M) growth credit facility from Mighty Partners, announced 2025-09-26 on the company press page (the url; FinTech Global repeated it on 2025-09-30, saved as us-deckard-fintechglobal.html). This is non-dilutive debt, not equity. Converted at the ECB reference rate for 2025-09-26, 1 USD = 0.85675 EUR (api.frankfurter.dev), giving €3,341,325. The same page states that VC firm EVP has committed $10.3M across several rounds.
summary: Deckard's Rentalscape finds short-term rental listings in a municipality, matches them to addresses and permits, flags unregistered hosts and automates collection of tourist and occupancy tax. More than 400 jurisdictions in the US, Canada and Australia use it, and it took a $3.9M growth credit facility in September 2025 to expand into long-term-rental compliance.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: Czech towns collect a stay fee (poplatek z pobytu, up to 50 CZK a person a night) but cannot see who rents flats short-term. In register p-0040, the MMR is quoted (Česká justice, 2024-09-27) saying that 40-70% of stays booked through online platforms go unreported and towns lose about 55M CZK a year in fees. Prague has relied on an ad-hoc data exchange with the tax authority (GFŘ-Magistrát agreement, reported by Aktuálně.cz) and on citizens calling the city police. The buyers would be Prague and its districts, plus tourist towns and regions (Český Krumlov, Karlovy Vary, Krkonoše/Šumava municipalities, Brno). EU driver: Regulation (EU) 2024/1028 on short-term rental data has applied since 2026-05-20. Platforms must pass host and activity data to competent authorities, and member states may require a registration number. The Czech response is the planned eTurista register, which MMR plans to launch in 2027, with p-0040 recording full effect from January 2028. A town will then receive platform data but still has to match it against fee payments and pursue non-payers, and that matching and pursuit is Deckard's product. Urgency 2: the EU regulation is in force but Czech enforcement tooling is still being built. Scale 1: a niche segment of tourist municipalities. Recurrence 3: platform data arrives monthly and the fee is collected continuously. This touches p-0040, whose own note records 'TOWN SIDE: no Czech vendor'. That record deliberately does not claim the town side is open, because the state register may absorb it. MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED. Rentalscape was already named as a product in September 2019 (FinSMEs 2019-09-16, saved as us-deckard-2019.html), so it has been selling for more than 3 years. Customer count: 'more than 400 jurisdictions' (the url). Funding: over $4M of seed rounds by 2019 (FinSMEs), $10.3M committed by EVP, and the $3.9M 2025 facility (the url). title: Belfry — back office for security-guard companies: scheduling, timesheets, payroll and client billing in one system
money_note: $12M Series A announced 2025-01-21 (company press release, the url; also AlleyWatch 2025-01-29 and Axios, saved as support-belfry-alleywatch.html and support-belfry-axios.html). Converted at the ECB reference rate for 2025-01-21, 1 USD = 0.96553 EUR (api.frankfurter.dev): 12,000,000 x 0.96553 = 11,586,360 EUR. Total raised $20M.
summary: New York-based Belfry sells security-guard companies one platform that runs shift scheduling, GPS timesheets, payroll matched to each client contract's pay rules, and client invoicing. It raised a $12M Series A led by Base10 Partners in January 2025.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: Czech private security is a large, low-margin, labour-heavy industry: 6,698 trade licences for security work and 44,216 employees of private security services at 2023-12-31, more than the Police ČR headcount (Unie soukromých bezpečnostních služeb via SECURITAS ČR press release 2024-01-30, saved as support-securitas-cz-sbs.html). The same release puts the minimum wage cost of one 24/7 guarded post at about 202 CZK per hour and says state tenders repeatedly come in about 30% below it, so margin depends on exact overtime, premium and billing control. That is Belfry's pitch: each client contract bills at its own rate while guards are paid by site, time of day, overtime and holiday rules (Axios, support-belfry-axios.html). Czech buyers are the mid-sized agencies (tens to hundreds of guards) that run attendance, a separate payroll package and invoicing by hand in between; Czech labour law adds night, weekend and holiday premiums to each shift. No Czech legal trigger: Czechia still has no private-security-services act (SECURITAS release, 2024-01-30). Several Czech vendor blogs claim a 'zákon 308/2024 Sb.' licensing regime from 2026, but 308/2024 Sb. is an unrelated MPSV notice (zakonyprolidi.cz, saved as support-zakonyprolidi-2024-308-unrelated.html), so no law is assumed. Urgency 0: no dated Czech or EU event. Scale 1: one industry segment. Recurrence 3: payroll and billing every pay cycle. MATURITY (abroad): EARLY by the test. Series A limb met (the url, 2025-01-21). Named customers: Merchants Security Service, Dayton OH (the url) and SMR Security Services, MPI Protective Services, Covey Security (belfrysoftware.com home, saved as support-belfry-home.html). The >=3-years-selling limb is NOT evidenced: the company dates from about 2022 with a first seed round in April 2023 (Tracxn/CB Insights search snippets, not saved), and no saved page shows sales before 2023-09. Would flip to ESTABLISHED on a dated pre-2023-09 customer. CZ CHECK: Czech-language queries: 'software pro bezpečnostní agentury plánování směn strážných docházka fakturace'; 'aplikace pro ostrahu objektů kontrolní obchůzky strážný elektronická kniha služeb'; 'bezpečnostní agentura systém mzdy strážných fakturace klientům hodinová sazba objekt směny jedna aplikace'. Surfaces: google-cz, ares, own-funded-ledger (no Belfry and no guard-operations vendor in the 5,994-record funded index). FOUND: TOUCHGUARD (TTC apki, s.r.o., IČO 19403429, ARES datumVzniku 2023-06-01; site claims 14 years of app development and names G4S Secure Solutions (CZ), Zentiva, UNIPETROL and others as customers; saved as cz-touchguard.html). competes: adjacent. It sells patrol tours, lone-worker protection, digital forms and attendance/shift headcount for security agencies. Its attendance page says worked hours are exported to payroll, and it does no payroll or client billing, which are Belfry's core. maturity: established (named customers). DOBRÁ AGENTURA, s.r.o. (IČO 26453118, datumVzniku 2001-08-17), PatrolControl GSM patrol and attendance systems. competes: adjacent (patrol and attendance hardware, no payroll or billing). maturity: established by age, no customer evidence checked. Horizontal attendance tools (KS program, Fingera, GIRITON) and general payroll/accounting packages. competes: adjacent (not security-specific, no contract-rate payroll-to-billing link). Verdict: absent. No Czech vendor of security-specific scheduling-to-payroll-to-billing software was found. The closest, TOUCHGUARD, covers the field-operations half. POSITIVE CONTROL: google-cz query 'česká aplikace pro zadávání přeprav dopravcům tendrování přeprav rezervace nakládky time sloty' surfaced Ringil (ringil.com/funkce/sprava-tendru), PASSED. ARES name search 'Wultra' returned Wultra s.r.o. IČO 03643174 (datumVzniku 2014-12-15), PASSED. The same google-cz method also surfaced six Czech sports-club membership vendors for a screened candidate, so it does produce positives in this category.
